1. myinfo.providencehealthcare.org (139.173.238.202)
2. myinfo.vch.ca (139.173.78.144)
3. 10.248.200.216
4. 10.248.200.217

Based on BigIPReport (http://ltmreport.bccss.org/#m=v&q=139.173.238.202), 139.173.238.202 and 139.173.78.144 appear to be behind load balancers and (10.248.200.216, 10.248.200.217) are their two pool members. If the servers are required and are in use, please install a renewed certificate by April 3rd to avoid access issues (please engage network core team if help is needed for the cert updates of the load balancer pool members).

Thanks,
SOC team
